::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `SetHistogramBarEffect`

Sets bar appearance (in histograms\index{graphs!histograms}).

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
SetHistogramBarEffect(BoxEffect effect)
```

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| [`BoxEffect`](#boxeffect) effect | The effect to apply to the bars in histograms. |
:::
